item.title: [CRITICAL] GHSA: s2n-quic has excessive memory allocation
item.description: s2n-quic is a Rust implementation of the QUIC protocol. An unauthenticated user can attempt to exhaust server memory on an s2n-quic endpoint by sending crafted CRYPTO frames with high offsets. The buffer used for processing CRYPTO frames does not enforce a maximum size. In the worst case, a single 1200-byte packet can cause approximately 9.4 MB of allocation.
